mapper.select: SELECT id,semester_code AS code FROM semester WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,college_code AS code FROM college WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,total_rows AS totalRows,success_rows AS successRows,failure_rows AS failureRows FROM import_batch WHERE source_sha256=#{sourceSha256} AND semester_id=#{semesterId} AND source_scope_college_id=#{sourceScopeCollegeId} AND status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT id,course_id AS courseId,semester_id AS semesterId, source_scope_college_id AS sourceScopeCollegeId, official_offering_code AS officialOfferingCode,source_offering_key AS sourceOfferingKey, display_name AS displayName,activity_type AS activityType,class_group_text AS classGroupText, student_count AS studentCount,status FROM course_offering WHERE source_offering_key=#{sourceOfferingKey}

SELECT id,display_name AS displayName,normalized_name AS normalizedName, location_group AS locationGroup,location_type AS locationType FROM location WHERE normalized_name=#{normalizedName} AND location_group=#{locationGroup} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,employee_no AS employeeNo,display_name AS displayName,normalized_name AS normalizedName, source_teacher_key AS sourceTeacherKey,identity_status AS identityStatus FROM teacher WHERE source_teacher_key=#{sourceTeacherKey} ORDER BY id

SELECT s.id,s.offering_id AS offeringId,s.weekday,s.start_section AS startSection, s.end_section AS endSection,s.location_id AS locationId,s.week_mask AS weekMask, s.raw_week_text AS rawWeekText,s.source_schedule_key AS sourceScheduleKey, l.display_name AS locationDisplayName,l.normalized_name AS locationNormalizedName, l.location_group AS locationGroup,l.location_type AS locationType FROM class_schedule s JOIN location l ON l.id=s.location_id WHERE s.source_schedule_key=#{sourceScheduleKey}
SELECT week_no FROM schedule_week WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} ORDER BY week_no
SELECT teacher_id FROM schedule_teacher WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} ORDER BY teacher_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_week WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_teacher WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE import_batch SET success_rows=#{successRows},failure_rows=0,status='SUCCESS',finished_at=#{finishedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_timetable_row() VALUES ( #{source.rawJson} FORMAT JSON )
